entries.description: Newer Super Mario Bros. Wii is a fan-made hack for New Super Mario Bros. Wii, a 2D platformer released for the Wii in 2009. Newer, a "full unofficial sequel", has new levels, graphics, music, enemies, and other features, in addition to a greater level amount than the vanilla game. Newer was released on June 7th, 2013.
